Class RouteConditions

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.web.router.builder.RouteConditions
@Internal public final class RouteConditions extends Object
Normalizes and evaluates route conditions and value matchers.

A condition is normalized when its route is built: nested RouteCondition.AllOf and RouteCondition.AnyOf are flattened, a double negation and a duplicate are removed, a combination that is always or never met is folded, and the parts of a combination are ordered cheapest first, stably: the methods, then the lookups of a value (ValueMatcher.Equals, ValueMatcher.OneOf, ValueMatcher.Present) and the time, then the affixes (ValueMatcher.StartsWith, ValueMatcher.EndsWith, ValueMatcher.Contains), then the regular expressions and the host and the client and peer addresses, then the RouteCondition.Custom conditions, in the order they were declared. The evaluation stops at the first part that decides.

Since:
5.3.0

Denis Stepanov
